title: Vision worker raw output, v1
description: What the Python worker writes for one video: per-frame detections in pixels and nothing else. The API turns this into reps, velocity, bar path and checks (ADR 0017, choice 2A), so a new model changes only the worker. Internal to Vision and tested by both the Python and C# suites; never returned to tenants.

schemaVersion.description: This format's version. A breaking change is a new file (v2.json).

jobId.description: The job this output belongs to.

worker.description: What produced this output, for reproducing and comparing results.

poseModel.description: The pose model and variant, for example mediapipe-pose-landmarker-full@0.10.14.

barDetector.description: The bar detector and its version, for example opencv-hsv-plates@1.

video.description: The video as the worker decoded it. Pixel coordinates in frames are in this width and height, after applying the video's rotation.

frames.description: One entry per analysed frame, in time order. Frame times come from the video's timestamps, since phone video often has a variable frame rate.

frame.description: What was detected in one frame. A detector that found nothing writes null rather than a guess.

index.description: The frame's number in the video, from 0.

t.description: Seconds from the start of the video.

bar.description: The bar's end, seen as the plate's centre, or null when no plate was found.

pose.description: The lifter's landmarks, or null when no body was found.

bar.description: A detected plate, in pixels from the top-left of the frame. radiusPx with the job's declared plate diameter gives the scale (ADR 0017, choice 3A).

landmark.description: One body point, in pixels from the top-left of the frame.

pose.description: Named body points, so the format doesn't depend on one model's landmark numbering. A point the model doesn't report is left out.
